# NEW 2026-11-21 v8.0 Yuan Early Modern Line (oe_yem_, slot 59, 1450-1750). Generated by gen_yuan_early_modern.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Independent fallback monthly pulse for Restored Yuan Early Modern Line (slot 59, 1450-1750).
# Ensures progression even if BYZ fell or before slot 59 is wired into oe_mainline_lock.txt.
# Rebel-guarded per fx17_rebel_guard.py; idempotent per calendar month via oe_yem_ran_m.
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_yem_fallback_pulse } }

oe_yem_fallback_pulse = {
    trigger = {
        current_date >= 1450.1.1
        current_date < 1750.1.1
        is_rebel_country = no
        OR = {
            tag = CHI
            AND = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no }
        }
        NOT = { global_var:oe_yem_ran_m ?= oe_yem_m_now }
    }
    effect = {
        oe_ml_mark_start = yes
        if = { limit = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes } oe_yem_monthly = yes }
    }
}
